title: How to Fill and Submit an Incident Report
content:
ARTICLE: How to Fill and Submit an Incident Report (KA-007)
SYSTEM: Quality Portal
DEPARTMENT: Quality and Patient Safety
VERSION: 2.2
OVERVIEW: This comprehensive operating guide details how hospital personnel should interact with the Quality Portal module to execute how to fill and submit an incident report safely and reliably.
STEPS:
Step 1: Open the Quality Portal client terminal on any networked SMCH workstation and log in with role credentials.
Step 2: Enter the patient's unique UHID or Case Number to load active records.
Step 3: Access the designated submenu corresponding to How to Fill and Submit an Incident Report and verify current patient status.
Step 4: Input all required clinical or administrative parameters, ensuring mandatory fields are validated.
Step 5: Verify preview confirmation modal and click 'Submit' to persist changes to the database.
Step 6: Print barcode, acknowledgement chit, or receipt as required by hospital compliance.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Connection timeout: Verify LAN cable connection or contact IT Helpdesk.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Permission Denied: Ensure user account has the assigned role in staff master permissions.
Contact Quality and Patient Safety coordinator or IT Operations Support at Extension 1033 (Email: it@smch.in).
